items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: I haven’t the slightest idea, well Trane heard everything... I got a good idea how he put all that together.

ctx.x: So when you use the term “knock out drag out” you are talking about really wailing.
Yeah you know, that’s right, what’s going on. Like you say Trane stark raving mad. Trane was just into his thing, I mean that’s what he wanted to do.
Where did that inspiration for that kind of playing come from? Do you have any idea?
